sources.title: [llama] AutoTokenizer does not add `eos_token` at the end - GitHub
sources.snippet: The reason behind this is that the post_processor is responsible of adding the eos and bos tokens. The processor is initialised when the slow tokenizer is converted to the fast version, and changing the argument on the fly will not result in a change of the processor. I'll open a PR to make sure that changing the eos and bos update the processor.
